Fire breaks out at Mexican fair, kills 5 people

At least five people are dead as a result of a fire at a huge fairground in southeastern Mexico, authorities said on May 7, 2026. The blaze, whose cause is still unknown, broke out early in Villahermosa, in Tabasco state, and has now been brought under control, Civil Protection said. According to local media, the fire spread while a concert attended by thousands of people was taking place.

SAX ANTONIO MARTINEZ
